name: AHK-Cu
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: AHK-Cu (AU) is a copper-complexed peptide supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 2 pack sizes: 50 mg, 100 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. Store the lyophilized powder at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is AHK-Cu tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: AHK-Cu is released lot by lot — HPLC for purity (≥99.0% (HPLC)) plus MS for mass — and the AU certificate lists the measured values alongside the identity entry (CAS 300801-03-0, formula C15H24CuN6O4, 415.94 Da).

faq.question: How should AHK-Cu be stored?
faq.answer: Dry powder for AHK-Cu: store at −20 °C. Working solution: 2–8 °C, used within the window printed on the AU lot certificate.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for AHK-Cu?
faq.answer: AHK-Cu is stocked in 2 pack sizes (50 mg, 100 mg), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $70.90; 10–49 kits falls to $65.22 (−8%) and 50+ to $60.26 (−15%).

compliance: For Research, Laboratory, and Analytical Use Only. Not for Human or Veterinary Use.
